description: Accepted size baseline and release budget for the compiled Default Style Bundle, measured from the styles-aggregate packed-consumer fixture's production CSS output. See docs/release/style-bundle-budget.md for the review and update process.

budget.derivation: Accepted baseline plus roughly 4-5% headroom for routine fixes, rounded to clean limits (181,493 -> 190,000 raw; 27,067 -> 28,500 gzip). Lowered from 196,000/29,000 after the bundle shrank by 6,234 raw bytes against the previous baseline: 4,500 of that is the TanStack shell stylesheet moving out of the Default Style Bundle into the opt-in hell-ui/table-tanstack/styles.css entry point, and the remaining 1,734 predates this change. Intentional growth beyond this re-measures the baseline and re-derives the budget per docs/release/style-bundle-budget.md.
